status: diagnostic experiment; not a confirmatory test of the paper's main claims
purpose: Determine whether the sign reversal of a one-shot round-1 +2 offset between CLASSIC and GRAY_BGF persists when the BGF-style post-step module (black re-check + gray step) is switched on/off while the stopping rule, budget accounting and later-round baseline are held fixed.
keys: G0 pool keys 54..99 (46 keys), 2000 errors each, same seed discipline (SEED=20260901) as decoder_transfer

gray_0.role: gray step only, exploratory component (not an official decoder)

gray_p2.role: gray step only, exploratory component (not an official decoder)

postmask_p2.role: exploratory: gray mask computed from the un-offset baseline round-1 threshold

factor_mode_semantics.main_step: classic parallel BF; threshold = clip(binomial_threshold(current syndrome) + offset in round 1 only, [(d+1)/2, d]); every main round recomputes its baseline from the current syndrome
factor_mode_semantics.poststep: after the round-1 main step only: black re-check flips black positions whose new UPC >= (d+1)/2+1; then gray step flips round-1 gray candidates (threshold-gray_delta <= UPC < threshold at the pre-flip state) whose new UPC >= (d+1)/2+1
factor_mode_semantics.stopping: continue on a no-flip main round; stop on zero syndrome or after 20 main rounds (classic rule)
factor_mode_semantics.budget_accounting: post-step UPC scans are recorded separately and do not consume the 20 main rounds; total scans are reported
factor_mode_semantics.mask: unless maskbase is true, the gray mask is computed against the offset round-1 threshold, matching the BGF implementation; maskbase isolates the effect of mask recomposition

gate.gate_1_classic: poststep=none arms must reproduce archived decoder_transfer_full.npz fail_classic_0 and fail_classic_p2 exactly, and the round-1 black flip counts must match first_classic_0 and first_classic_p2
gate.gate_2_bgf_port: a bgf-compatible replica of the post-step (substeps counted, blocked-stop) must reproduce bgf_vasseur and archived fail_bgf_0 / fail_bgf_p2 exactly on a 3-key x 200-error verification sample

estimand.primary: interaction Delta = (p(post_p2) - p(post_0)) - (p(plain_p2) - p(plain_0)), averaged over keys on the risk-difference scale; 95% key-clustered percentile bootstrap, B=10000, seed=20260905
estimand.secondary: per-cell DFR and RR versus the within-policy baseline; component interactions for recheck-only and gray-only; mask-base contrast (postmask_p2 - post_p2)
estimand.zero_events: rule-of-three upper bound 3/N, with the binomial-trial assumption stated

multiplicity: one prespecified primary interaction; all component and mask contrasts are exploratory and reported nominally
falsification: If the primary Delta interval includes 0, the claim that the post-step changes the sign of the +2 effect under aligned rules is not supported; the observed BGF/CLASSIC difference must then be attributed to other implementation differences or sampling, and must not be assigned to the post-step module.
disclosure: Diagnostic recombinations are not official decoders. The first-round gray mask changes when the main threshold is offset; maskbase isolates that separately. No wall-clock or production claim is made from this Python carrier.
